critical_code_review_comments: VoiceSearchButton component properly handles Web Speech API unavailability with graceful error messages
Dragon AI modal has good UX with visual feedback for listening state (color change, text update)
Text input in Dragon AI works correctly and integrates with /api/assistant backend
Quick actions provide good discoverability for common tasks
Response display handles long content with scrollable area
context_for_next_testing_agent: Voice Search and Dragon AI features verified working. Voice Search button (data-testid='voice-search-btn') is visible inside job search input on /search page. Dragon AI button (data-testid='dragon-ai-button') is a floating button at bottom-right that opens modal with mic button and text input. Both features use Web Speech API which requires microphone access - in headless browser testing, voice recognition will fail gracefully with error toast. Text input in Dragon AI works and returns AI responses from /api/assistant endpoint.
